title: DOW-UAP-PR107, Unresolved UAP Report, Eastern United States, 2020
what_is_it: A US government case entry for an unresolved UAP incident, consisting of a short infrared video clip and an accompanying descriptive summary.
interpretation_warnings: The government explicitly states the description carries no analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination: 'Readers should not interpret any part of this description as reflecting an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination.'
No source text was extracted from the PDF; most facts derive from the war.gov CSV description and metadata rather than a primary document.
The video shows only an unresolved 'area of contrast' on an infrared sensor — no identification of the object, its size, distance, or origin is provided.
Single-source: the report originates from one submitting command with no corroborating sensor or observer data described.
Infrared 'contrast' tracking can be affected by sensor artefacts, parallax, and platform motion; the footage alone does not establish anomalous flight characteristics.

key_facts.source_quote: aboard a U.S. military platform in 2020

verifiable_claims.claim: The report consists of 28 seconds of infrared video from a US military platform captured in 2020.
